reuse.why: Reuses the existing ensureAccountNotLinked guard as the single entry point for all providers, but copies unlinkAccount's 'unlinked state' field reset instead of extracting it into a shared local-unlink helper.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset block is a verbatim copy of the one inside unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts; the flag threading through six link functions is unavoidable given the existing structure.

placement.why: A function named ensureAccountNotLinked, a precondition check, now also mutates another account, and does so before the new link is created; the takeover would read better as an explicit step in the link flow.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading through the provider link functions and the takeover logic plus a test are changed.

maintainability.why: The unlinked-account field list now lives in two places that must stay in sync, and the side effect is hidden behind a guard-style name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked writes the unlink field reset directly with db.updateAccount instead of sharing the local part of unlinkAccount (accounts/app.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset in link.ts is verbatim from unlinkAccount, with a comment explaining why; not disguised.
